summary: Boolean gate for session type 5 used by the overtaking path. Returns 0 when the global session type (dword_7C56A4) is not 5, and also returns 0 when the vehicle is on lap 2 (this+0x4094 == 2) while not being called to the box (this+0x454C != 1). Otherwise returns 1, allowing the caller to proceed. Invoked per-frame by Overtaking (0042AF70).

local_names.this: per-vehicle session state carrying lap and pit-call fields

operations.description: Session-type gate: when dword_7C56A4 is not equal to 5 the function returns 0 immediately
Lap/pit gate: returns 0 when this+0x454C (callToBox) is not 1 AND this+0x4094 (lapOfRun) is equal to 2, i.e. on lap 2 without a pit call
Returns 1 when the session type is 5 and either the vehicle is called to the box or it is not yet on lap 2
Invoked per-frame from Overtaking (0042AF70) as the session gate for its decision logic
